defs.def: a particular thing that sb does 行为；行动；所为

ex.s: “Impetuous has two definitions: rushing with great force or violence; acting suddenly, with little thought. ”
ex.t: “Impetuous有两个释义：以巨大的力量或暴力冲撞；突然行动，欠思考。”

ex.s: They may apply universally to all acts of evolution.
ex.t: 它们可能普遍适用于进化的一切行为。

ex.s: And that’s what makes the act of rereading so rich and transformative.
ex.t: 而这正是重读这种行为如此丰富且具变革性的原因。

ex.s: In that sense, I’m pretty sure volunteering is more of a selfish act than I’d freely like to admit.
ex.t: 从这个意义上说，我很确定志愿服务比我愿意承认的更像是一种自私的行为。

ex.s: Mr Smith’s act    30    much of the public’s attention.
ex.t: 史密斯先生的行为____30____了公众的很多关注。

ex.s: He also won praise from social media users after Mr Anderson    31    about the act of kindness on Facebook.
ex.t: 在安德森先生在脸书上____31____这一善举后，他也赢得了社交媒体用户的赞扬。

ex.s: In the case of emperors, the act required the person to touch their head to the ground.
ex.t: 在皇帝的情况下，该礼节要求人把头触地。

defs.def: a law that has been passed by a parliament （议会通过的）法案，法令

ex.s: What is a direct result of the Act passed in 1934?
ex.t: 1934年通过的法案的直接结果是什么？

ex.s: At the top of a second page, put the heading “Acts of kindness.” On this one, list all the positive things you’ve done for others.
ex.t: 在第二页的顶部写下标题“善举”。在这一页上，列出你为他人做过的所有积极的事情。

ex.s: Already, a number of films, including "Water for Elephants," "The Hangover Part Ⅱ" and "Zookeeper," have drawn the anger of activists who say the creatures acting in them haven’t been treated properly.
ex.t: 已经有不少影片，包括《大象的眼泪》《宿醉2》和《动物园看守》，引来了活动人士的愤怒，他们说片中动物的待遇不当。

ex.s: Under this Act, all waterfowl hunters 16 years of age and over must annually purchase and carry a Federal Duck Stamp.
ex.t: 根据该法案，所有16岁及以上的水禽猎人每年必须购买并携带一张联邦鸭票。

defs.def: a way of behaving that is not sincere but is intended to have a particular effect on others 假装

ex.s: So, whoever you are, thank you for the random act of   54   that not only helped my mother out, but   55   too.
ex.t: 所以，无论你是谁，谢谢你这次随机的____54____之举，它不仅帮了我母亲，也____55____。

defs.def: one of the main divisions of a play, an opera, etc. （戏剧、歌剧等的）一幕

ex.s: One small act of kindness led to another.
ex.t: 一个小小的善举引发了另一个。

defs.def: one of several short pieces of entertainment in a show 一项表演

ex.s: He felt he was good at acting.
ex.t: 他觉得自己擅长表演。

ex.s: Apply their acting skills.
ex.t: 运用他们的表演技巧。

ex.s: To share his acting experience.
ex.t: 分享他的表演经验。

ex.s: To share his acting experience.
ex.t: 分享他的表演经验。

ex.s: Leslie Nielsen’s devotion to acting is wonderfully inspiring.
ex.t: 莱斯利·尼尔森对表演的投入极其鼓舞人心。

defs.def: a performer or group of musicians 表演者；音乐人组合
to do sth for a particular purpose or in order to deal with a situation 做事；行动

ex.s: Each chapter concludes with a collection of practices, which are designed to help you act on the big ideas of the chapter.
ex.t: 每一章都以一系列实践练习收尾，这些练习旨在帮助你将本章的重要理念付诸行动。

ex.s: “I know I can act under pressure in a scary situation.”
ex.t: “我知道在可怕的情况下我能顶住压力采取行动。”

ex.s: But if governments don’t want a data economy controlled by a few giants, they must act soon.
ex.t: 但如果政府不希望数据经济被少数巨头控制，就必须尽快行动。

ex.s: She explains we are at a “tipping point” in history and must act now to prevent an extinction-level event for humanity.
ex.t: 她解释说，我们正处于历史上的一个“临界点”，必须立刻行动，以防人类遭遇灭绝级事件。

defs.def: to behave in a particular way 表现得

ex.s: They acted awkwardly while feeding the dog.
ex.t: 他们在喂狗时表现得很笨拙。

ex.s: Her inability to act her age.
ex.t: 她不能表现得符合她的年龄。

ex.s: Think about the singing "Home is where you are loved the most and act the worst".
ex.t: 想想那句歌词“家是你被爱得最多、也表现得最糟的地方”。

ex.s: I’d come face to face with the homeless: How should I act?
ex.t: 我曾面对面遇到无家可归者：我该怎么表现？

defs.def: to pretend by your behaviour to be a particular type of person 假装
to perform a part in a play or film/movie 扮演（戏剧、电影中的角色）

ex.s: In my opinion, the funniest thing about Charlie Chaplin was the way he walked when he was acting as the Tramp, who is his most famous character.
ex.t: 在我看来，查理·卓别林最有趣的是他扮演“流浪汉”（他最著名的角色）时的走路方式。

ex.s: Writing was so difficult and painful for me that my teacher had allowed me to present my paper on the sinking of the Titanic by acting out a play, where I played all the parts.
ex.t: 写作对我来说太困难、太痛苦，以至于老师允许我通过表演一出戏来呈现关于泰坦尼克号沉没的论文，在戏里我扮演了所有角色。

ex.s: Writing was so difficult and painful for me that my teacher had allowed me to present my paper on the sinking of the Titanic by acting out a play, where I played all the parts.
ex.t: 写作对我来说太困难、太痛苦，以至于老师允许我通过表演一出戏来呈现关于泰坦尼克号沉没的论文，在戏里我扮演了所有角色。

ex.s: When he was writing his novels, Charles Dickens would act out the parts of the characters, He’d make faces in the mirror, and change his voice for each character.
ex.t: 查尔斯·狄更斯写小说时，会表演角色的部分，对着镜子做鬼脸，并为每个角色变换声音。

ex.s: Act out the conversation to talk about the road trips across China.
ex.t: 表演对话来谈论穿越中国的公路旅行。

ex.s: Wonderment from acting out the stories.
ex.t: 表演故事带来的奇妙感受。

defs.def: to perform a particular role or function 充当；起作用

ex.s: After that incident, I stopped acting as a “Chinese teacher.” Instead of correcting others when they were struggling to pronounce my name, I just smiled and nodded approvingly.
ex.t: 那次事件后，我不再担任“汉语老师”。“当别人挣扎着说出我的名字时，我没有纠正别人，我只是微笑着点头表示赞许。

ex.s: Act as role models for them.
ex.t: 以身作则为他们树立榜样。

ex.s: “it seemed like the perfect chance for natural selection to act on a population," said Dr Ilardo.
ex.t: “这似乎是自然选择作用于一个种群的绝佳机会，”伊拉尔多博士说。

defs.def: to have an effect on sth （对 … ）有作用，有影响

ex.s: Not everyone acts the same in response to events, and that is why what triggers one person may or may not trigger another.
ex.t: 并非每个人对事件的反应都一样，这正是触发一个人的事可能触发也可能不触发另一个人的原因。

ex.s: This example should act as an inspiration for all cities.
ex.t: 这个例子应该对所有城市起到启发作用。

ex.s: In 1975, grizzlies were listed under the Endangered Species Act.
ex.t: 1975年，灰熊被列入《濒危物种法》保护名录。

defs.def: to perform a ceremony or show how sth happened, as if performing a play 履行（仪式）；将 … 表演出来

ex.s: I always read ,using different voices ,as though I were acting out the stories with my voice and they loved it !It was a special time to bond with my children and it filled them with the wonderment of books .
ex.t: 我总是用不同的声音朗读，仿佛用声音把故事演出来，他们很喜欢！那是一段与孩子建立亲密关系的特别时光，也让他们充满对书籍的惊奇。

defs.def: to act a part in a real situation 充当（真实情况中的角色）
to behave badly 表现不好；捣乱
to not work as it should 出毛病
